title: USCIS Updates Guidance for Afghans and Iraqis Seeking Special Immigrant Classification
paragraphs: USCIS is updating guidance in the USCISPolicy Manualregarding Afghan and Iraqi nationals seeking special immigrant classification. The new guidance is effective immediately.

For more information, see thePolicy Alert  (PDF, 347.6 KB). Visit thePolicy Manual Feedbackpage to provide feedback on this update. USCIS welcomes feedback on this guidance and will consider any feedback received in future updates.
